# HSR Utility

> HSR Utility is an indie Android studio building carefully crafted wallpaper and
> ringtone apps for specific cultural audiences. Its apps are Pakiza (an Islamic
> lifestyle app, coming soon to Google Play) and Arul (South Indian wallpapers, live
> on Google Play). The studio itself has no religious affiliation.

## Key facts

- **Studio:** HSR Utility. Indie Android studio, founded 2026. HSR Utility is the brand
  name; the registered company behind it is **HSR Utility Apps Private Limited**, A3002,
  Adonia Hiranandani, Garden, South AvenuePowai, Mumbai, Mumbai, Mumbai, Maharashtra,
  400076, India.
- **Apps** — both Android-only, built with Flutter:
  - **Pakiza** — Islamic lifestyle app. Shorts-style vertical feed of static and live
    (video) wallpapers with one-tap apply, a curated Islamic ringtone library, and
    offline Jummah + Islamic-calendar reminders (fully local — no location, no push).
    Localized into 11 Indian languages. Light/dark/system theming.
    **Status: coming soon to Google Play.**
  - **Arul** — South Indian wallpapers. Shorts-style feed of static and live wallpapers,
    category browse, ringtones, and upload-your-own-wallpaper submissions.
    **Status: live on Google Play** —
    https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.hsrutility.arul
- **Model:** browsing and previewing is always free. Applying wallpapers, setting
  ringtones and sharing are premium, billed via UPI Autopay after a one-time free trial.
- **Sign-in:** Google Sign-In (name, email, profile photo). No phone number, no password.
- **Account deletion:** instant from inside either app (Settings → Delete account);
  email support@hsrutility.com as a fallback if the app is already uninstalled.
- **Contact:** support@hsrutility.com — replies within 48 hours. Phone: +91 7827100871.
- **This website:** no analytics, no cookies, no third-party requests of any kind.

- [Support & FAQ](https://hsrutility.com/support): Questions about content, pricing, sign-in, Android support, and reporting bugs.
- [Privacy Policy](https://hsrutility.com/privacy): What data Pakiza and Arul collect, how it is used, and how it is protected.

- [Delete My Account](https://hsrutility.com/delete-account): How to permanently delete an account and its data.
